# Pricing Perspective

> Research by Marcus Gawronsky and Chun-Sung Huang on probability-valued firm information, financial dependence, spatial interaction, strategic repositioning, and portfolio risk.

## Papers

- [Systematic Covariance Envelopes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.23447): Quadratic Wasserstein geometry yields sharp conditional covariance endpoints over admissible exposure couplings.
- [Wasserstein-Barycentric Interaction Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29669): Target-anchored transport and simplex reconstruction produce a directed peer field for spatial factor models.
- [Portfolio Risk Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29692): Multi-firm Wasserstein-2 dispersion produces one-sided portfolio-risk certificates without cross-asset return covariances.
- [Information Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37820): A strategic model separates opportunity effects from crowding and studies the persistence of firm peer structure.

## Authors

- Marcus Gawronsky - https://github.com/marcusinthesky
- Chun-Sung Huang - https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Chun-sung-Huang

## Blog

- [No returns: Mega-IPOs and the promise of AI as economic measurement](/blog/mega-ipos-ai-economic-measurement/): Mega-IPOs, public-private market convergence, and economically structured AI for financial measurement.
- [What are we actually studying when we study AI in finance?](/blog/what-are-we-studying-ai-in-finance/): AI as a tool for financial practice, a source of economic change, and a means of measurement.
- [Do language models in finance need a Markowitz moment?](/blog/language-models-markowitz-moment/): From security-level text signals to what language-derived information means inside a portfolio.
- [Reproducibility is a graph, not a lockfile](/blog/reproducibility-is-a-graph/): How Nix, DVC, Semflow, typed interfaces, and formal verification make the path from data to publication inspectable.
- [The tidal wave of AI research in finance](/blog/tidal-wave-of-ai-research-in-finance/): Model age, retrieval efficiency, market efficiency, and a South African research agenda.
- [Why finance needs vintage, reproducible encoders](/blog/vintage-reproducible-ettax-models/): The EttaX architecture and why dated model identities belong in financial econometrics.
